input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, USA, excluding conflict of laws provisions and excluding the 1980 United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with the then-current commercial arbitration rules of the American Arbitration Association ("RULES").
input.rationale: California law with a single-arbitrator AAA arbitration seated in San Francisco County and judgment enforceable in the California courts sits within the fallback (California law and forum); the seat is domestic, so there is no foreign-arbitration walk-away issue. We note only that we would prefer courts over mandatory arbitration.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party shall have the right to assign this Agreement in connection with the merger or acquisition of such party or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent, except in the case where such transaction involves a direct competitor of the other party where consent of the other party will be required.
input.rationale: Assignment is mutual with an M&A/asset-sale carve-out for us, and no Commerce One termination or re-pricing right is triggered by our change of control, which meets the fallback. We note two sub-optimal points: the consent standard is not qualified as "not unreasonably withheld", and consent is still required where the acquirer is a direct competitor of Commerce One.
